calcoli.title: Calculations
calcoli.caption: All service pricing formulas in one place. Try them below.
calcoli.formulaSale: total = Σ (product price × qty) — includes flexible prices
calcoli.formulaFixedCity: in city: service value + price/km × max(0, distance − included km)
calcoli.formulaFixedOutCity: out of city: out-of-city price × distance
calcoli.noteFixed: Distance calculated via Google Maps (pickup → delivery). The value is shown in the Price list.
calcoli.formulaHourly: value = max(1, hours) × hourly price (minimum 1 hour). Shown in the Price list.
calcoli.formulaWarehouse: fixed price + per-piece price × qty + delivery price
calcoli.corporateNotePart1: It is not a pricing formula: the system
calcoli.corporateNoteStrong: replicates the delivery to another partner
calcoli.corporateNotePart4: (the value is then calculated as a Sale for the recipient partner).

finance.title: Finance
finance.caption: Company takings and margins — sales services only
finance.vendutoStimatoHint: Estimated: the delivery line has no written price, so today's list price (variant or product) is used, not the sale day's.
finance.escluseCorporate: · {{n}} sales tied to corporate services are left out.
finance.assumption: Each row is an ORDER. Where a linked Shopify order exists, sales value and shipping are WHAT THE CUSTOMER PAID online (from the Orders cache, refreshed nightly); deliveries instead show the price agreed with the partner. Profit = sales value − product value, gross and net of VAT (÷1.22). "Recorded fee" is the quota written on the delivery: the partner receives the product value MINUS the quota, so the total margin adds it (gross) to the net profit. The ≈ sign marks a sales value estimated from the price list where there is neither a Shopify order nor a written price.
finance.searchPh: Order no., delivery, recipient or partner
finance.capped: Showing {{n}} rows: the chosen period holds more. Narrow the dates or filter, or the totals will not match the list.
finance.onlySales: Takings: only deliveries whose service is of type Sale, cancelled ones excluded.
finance.excluded: This period has {{n}} more with other services (delivery only, hourly, warehouse, corporate): they are not sales and stay out of the figures.
finance.anomalie: {{n}} rows are not reliable and are flagged in the table: the totals include them as they are.

partnerAnagrafica.mirrorBody: The registry record this partner is linked to was created by the platform itself: it holds our own data, so “no differences” is guaranteed and proves nothing. Another registry record carries the same VAT number, and is almost certainly the real one:
partnerAnagrafica.pullHint: Pulls only the ticked fields into the platform. Rows where the registry is empty cannot be ticked: an empty value never overwrites a real one. Yellow rows are trade name and address — the registry holds the company, this page the outlet, so they start unticked.

partnerAnagrafica.pushLinkHint: The registry record already exists: it gets linked to this partner and the fields above are overwritten with ours.
partnerAnagrafica.pushUpdateHint: Already linked: the platform fields are written over the registry ones.
partnerAnagrafica.pushBlocked: The registry holds several possible records: pick one by hand, so another isn’t created.
